name: Update Press – Keep your users informed about changes and updates
author: Seventh Sky

sections.description:
Update Press is a comprehensive WordPress plugin designed to help website owners effortlessly display, manage, and track update notifications with advanced user engagement features. Featuring a floating widget with a responsive sidebar drawer, it dynamically fetches and showcases the latest updates in real time with built-in analytics and user feedback capabilities.

The plugin is perfect for businesses offering software, SaaS, digital products, or any service that requires regular communication with users about updates, new features, or important announcements. The floating widget includes a notification badge that highlights updates from the past seven days, ensuring users never miss important information.

Key Capabilities:
– Smart Notifications: Automatic badge highlighting for recent updates
– User Engagement: Built-in like/dislike feedback system for each update
– Analytics Tracking: Comprehensive read tracking and user interaction monitoring
– Private Mode: Option to make updates private and only accessible through the widget
– Admin Dashboard: Detailed analytics columns showing views and feedback statistics
– Mobile-First Design: Fully responsive and optimized for all devices
– Customizable Display: Flexible settings for widget position, display count, and sorting options

The sidebar drawer opens to reveal a list of recent updates with real-time analytics display. Users can interact with updates through like/dislike buttons, and administrators can track engagement through comprehensive analytics in the WordPress admin panel. The plugin also offers Private Mode functionality, allowing sensitive updates to be accessible only through the widget while preventing search engine indexing.

Features

Core Widget Features:
– Interactive floating widget with customizable positioning (left/right)
– Responsive sidebar drawer with smooth animations
– Smart notification badge highlighting recent updates (7-day window)
– Real-time updates fetching via WordPress REST API
– Mobile-optimized design with touch-friendly interface

User Engagement & Analytics:
– Built-in like/dislike feedback system for each update
– Comprehensive read tracking and user interaction monitoring
– Real-time analytics display showing read counts and feedback statistics
– AJAX-powered interactions with instant UI updates
– Toast notifications for user feedback confirmation

Admin Management:
– Dedicated admin interface with analytics columns (Views & Feedback)
– Sortable analytics columns in updates list table
– Custom database tables for tracking reads and user feedback
– Flexible display settings (count, sorting, positioning)
– Category and tag management with custom colors

Privacy & Security:
– Private Mode feature to disable public indexing
– Search engine protection with noindex meta tags
– Access restrictions for direct links and archive pages
– Secure AJAX endpoints with nonce verification
– Complete admin control over update visibility

Customization Options:
– Widget position control (bottom left/right)
– Display count settings (all updates or custom limit)
– Sort order options (newest/oldest first)
– Category filtering and tag management
– Customizable tag colors and styling
– Flexible display rules (sitewide or specific pages)

sections.installation:
From WordPress Repository:
1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
3. Search for “updatepress” in the search box
4. Find “Update Press” by 7th Sky Software and click Install Now
5. After installation, click Activate to enable the plugin

Manual Installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file and upload it to /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu in WordPress.
3. Navigate to UpdatePress Settings to configure widget options, display settings, and privacy preferences.
4. Create your first update using the UpdatePress custom post type.
5. Configure categories and tags for better organization.
6. Enable the floating widget and customize its appearance and behavior.
7. Monitor user engagement through the analytics columns in the admin updates list.
sections.faq:
How does UpdatePress fetch updates?

UpdatePress uses a built-in WordPress REST API endpoint (/wp-json/updatepress/v1/updates) to fetch updates dynamically. The plugin creates a custom post type called “updatepress” where you can create and manage your updates directly from the WordPress admin.

Can I track user engagement with my updates?

Yes! UpdatePress includes comprehensive analytics features. You can track how many times each update has been read and see user feedback (likes/dislikes) directly in the admin updates list table. The analytics are displayed in real-time with sortable columns.

What is Private Mode and when should I use it?

Private Mode allows you to make updates accessible only through the floating widget drawer while preventing search engines from indexing them. This is perfect for internal announcements, beta features, or sensitive information that shouldn’t be publicly accessible.

Can I customize the floating widget appearance?

Yes, you can customize the widget position (left/right), display count, sort order, and enable/disable various features. The plugin also supports custom tag colors and flexible display rules for different pages.

Does UpdatePress support mobile devices?

Absolutely! UpdatePress is fully responsive and mobile-optimized. The floating widget and sidebar drawer work seamlessly on all devices with touch-friendly interactions and smooth animations.

Can I organize updates with categories and tags?

Yes, UpdatePress supports both categories and tags for organizing your updates. You can assign custom colors to tags and use category filtering in the widget for better user navigation.

How do users interact with updates?

Users can click the floating widget to open the sidebar drawer, browse through updates, read full content, and provide feedback using like/dislike buttons. All interactions are tracked and displayed in your admin analytics.
